reason: In the useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities hunk of change.patch (lines 471-472), the comment says all GrafanaPromRuleDTO rules are Grafana-managed, but the line below it sets `isAlertingRule = prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`. That checks whether the rule is an alerting rule rather than a recording rule, not whether it is Grafana-managed. The comment explains why the old `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule` check was dropped, not what the new line does.
